authority: Global stored-source read under authenticated TenantContext, active Meri request, RolesGuard standard_user. Current adapter/gateway authorization not established by DTO.
searchCount: total is returned groups; listed is captured before response trimming; hasMore uses (page-1)*perPage+listed, equivalent returned+omitted. totalBills nullable; later empty page may report unknown total and false hasMore.
searchTrimming: Response builder first reduces extra passages then drops whole trailing groups while over budget; giant remaining single group can still exceed producer budget. Any hard admitted10500 limit is stricter and must be disclosed.
searchGrouping: Grouped by bill; passage cursors can have different source versions within one group. Offset0 passage has null cursor.
cursor: Base64url JSON five-tuple; encoded byte roundtrip does not imply compact JSON; <=1024 encoded units; offset safe integer1..30000000; UUIDv4 revision and 64 lowercase hex text hash. Explicit requested version binds tuple; current revision/hash pointer is adapter-owned.
sequentialCoverage: 9000 UTF-16 window with high-surrogate boundary shortening; contentComplete only at offset0 terminal page; paginationComplete at terminal page; complete true for local page; truncated when continuation exists OR offset>0.
locatorCoverage: At most6 passages, each1000 UTF-16 units; query/parts/hits and excerpts, incomplete/truncated coverage even zero hits. No current-status or full-bill guarantee.
normalization: Canonical shared resolver with explicit trusted defaultCongress; source ambient default used local calendar year. Stronger malformed typed admission must be disclosed.
dates: FederalBillTextRow sourceModifiedAt and publishedAt nullable Date, fetchedAt required Date. CongressBill raw scalar rows preserve nullable dates/strings, Int fields, arrays and opaque committees JSON; no relation rows implied.
